capabilities.title: The agent's door opens onto the real data, from the engine's first step

verification.acceptance: From the first step in which a console engine exists, every reading from outside its process goes through a door inside that process: the engine's own end-to-end gate and the external harness at each theme read through it, no stdio sidecar exists, and no later removal has a sidecar to change; an agent on the developer's machine reads through it the telemetry the engine holds, filtered by service, time range, trace and text, with aggregates, one incident whole with its evidence and the incidents like it from the past, and the curated snapshot of recent telemetry; the test harness and the status command use the same door.

capabilities.title: What the door may do
capabilities.requirement: until the engine accepts connections from another host, the door answers on the engine's own host only; from the moment it can be reached from another host it answers only a party the node's owner has admitted, and admission has a lifecycle: how a party is admitted and how it is revoked, as the token has; it is stated where an admitted party's credential lives on the developer's machine — never in a repository, never in a log; the door is encrypted in transit; it reads the engine's stores (telemetry, incidents, reports, the engine's own state) and nothing else on the node: not the token, not configuration secrets, not files outside those stores; every answer is bounded in size and time, so no question can exhaust the node; what it returns was scrubbed at ingest; the one write it keeps (resolving an incident) is named as a write and can be switched off
capabilities.observed_gap: the sidecar's tools are local, unauthenticated, and one of them writes (it marks an incident resolved).

verification.acceptance: Before the engine accepts connections from another host the door answers on the engine's own host only; once it can be reached from another host it answers only an admitted party, a party is admitted and revoked in a stated way and a revoked party is refused; where an admitted party's credential lives on the developer's machine is stated, outside any repository and any log; the door's traffic is encrypted in transit; a request for the token, a configuration secret or a file outside the stores is refused; an answer too large or too slow is cut at a stated bound; what it returns was scrubbed at ingest; resolving an incident is named as a write and can be switched off.

capabilities.title: A new kind of error is news
